part.text: All 20 tests pass, including the previously failing `std_test.path` cases for `{:n}`/`{:g}`. Final diff:

Fixed in include/fmt/std.h only:

- `formatter<std::filesystem::path>` now parses presentation types `n` (native, default) and `g` (generic) after align/width/`?` (include/fmt/std.h:133-137).
- `format` selects `p.native()` or `p.generic_string<path::value_type>()` and passes it through the existing `get_path_string`/`write_escaped_path` conversion/escaping pipeline, so UTF-16→UTF-8 conversion on Windows and debug `?` escaping still work with generic paths.
- Helpers now operate on the passed native string (`std::filesystem::path(native).string<Char>()`) instead of re-reading `p`, keeping native output identical.

Verified: full build clean, `ctest` 20/20 passed (std-test, ranges, xchar, etc.).
